prompt: What's new in my fields this week?
expect: runs `aster refresh` (or explains why not) and `aster candidates --json`
searches the web for SSRN papers and discussion in at least the core fields
every item has an opened primary link and a date; web finds are labelled
records web finds with `aster add` and marks shown items with `aster seen`

prompt: Anything interesting in quantitative marketing since Monday?
expect: uses `--field marketing` and a window starting Monday
searches SSRN and marketing journals' online-first pages
says plainly if little is new
must_not: report machine learning items unrelated to marketing

prompt: What's everyone on X saying about the new open-weights model releases this week?
expect: identifies the releases from model cards or lab pages and links them
groups posts by release and separates announcements from independent discussion
states that web search covers X only partially
must_not: quote like counts not visible on a page
treat a post as the model card

prompt: Find recent working papers on LLMs as simulated consumers, from about the last three months.
expect: checks `aster candidates` and searches arXiv, SSRN and NBER
groups versions of the same work and gives each work's status
records new finds with `aster add`
must_not: include papers outside the window without saying so

prompt: Has arXiv 2610.01234 been published anywhere yet, and is anyone discussing it?
expect: runs `aster lookup arxiv:2610.01234`
checks OpenAlex or Crossref for a journal version and the platforms for discussion
answers with dates and links

prompt: Also follow the Journal of Finance and mute machine learning for now.
expect: edits the config file after showing the change
adds jf to quant-finance (or a field) and sets machine-learning tier to mute
runs `aster fields` to confirm

prompt: Explain the identification strategy in this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01234
expect: does not use Aster; reading one paper belongs to Finch
